governance.riskRationale: This correction changes the Tauri renderer capability boundary and therefore requires real runtime-authority proof plus independent review before integration.
governance.humanDirection: The repository owner explicitly requested correction of the startup lock defect. The correction restores the approved no-login default and does not add product, release, task, Wave, or gate authority.

trigger.observedSymptom: At startup the renderer showed the fail-closed Recovery required application-lock surface even though the installed default sign-in mode was none.
trigger.rootCause: The renderer intentionally registers the application-lock-changed listener before requesting application_lock_status. The main-window Tauri capability granted only the WebView inspector command, so Tauri 2.11.5 denied plugin:event|listen. The listener failure correctly forced recovery before the otherwise-valid no-login status could unlock the application.

rendererAuthorityAdded: Receive local application events in the main window
Remove a previously registered local event listener in the main window
intendedProjectionDelta.backendEventEmission: Unchanged. Existing Rust app.emit application-lock notifications remain backend-owned and do not depend on renderer emit permission.
intendedProjectionDelta.generatedProjection: apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/capabilities.json is the deterministic tracked Tauri capability projection refreshed by generate_context!; it carries exactly the same bounded permission delta as the source capability.

authorityThatMustNotExpand.applicationLockContract: Preserve the approved no-login default while retaining fail-closed behavior when lock monitoring cannot be established or produces malformed state.
authorityThatMustNotExpand.principalBoundary: Only the local main WebView may listen and unlisten. Other window labels and remote origins remain denied by the real Tauri runtime authority.
authorityThatMustNotExpand.writeBoundary: The renderer cannot emit or emit-to and receives no event default bundle or core default bundle.
authorityThatMustNotExpand.productBoundary: No sign-in policy, credential provider, Windows identity, project reopening, migration, persistence, release, or workflow authority changes.
authorityThatMustNotExpand.dataBoundary: No stored application-lock settings or user data are read, rewritten, migrated, or deleted by this maintenance increment.

acceptanceClosure.criterion: The capability remains receive-only and principal-scoped.
acceptanceClosure.proof: The same runtime authority test denies emit and emit_to, every permitted command for a secondary window label, and every permitted command for a remote Origin. acceptanceClosure.criterion: Installed mode none starts unlocked only after lock event monitoring succeeds.
acceptanceClosure.proof: The assembled application runtime confirms listener registration precedes status acquisition and a valid unlocked mode-none snapshot reaches applicationReady without a false recovery surface.
The assembled application runtime confirms denied and timed-out listeners plus malformed lock events render Recovery required and suppress the application shell, navigation, and footer.
